atoms.b: Sight, hearing, touch, smell and ((++taste feeling)) - human beings use their senses to perceive the world around them.

Each sense ((++organ finger)) picks up particular stimuli in the environment and sends information to the ((++brain mouth)) via the nervous system. This means that the brain constantly receives important information about what’s going on ((++around_us in_space)).

hint.text: A stimulus is a change in the environment which causes a reaction in the body. The plural is stimuli.
hint.label: Stimuli

atoms.b: Human beings have ((++five three)) sense organs: skin, eyes, ears, ((++nose chest)) and ((++tongue legs)). Each organ is perfectly adapted to perform its task.

instruction.text: Match each sense organ to the correct sense.

hint.text: Select an image to hear the name of the sense organ.

instruction.text: Select the correct sense to complete the sentences.

atoms.sound: We use our skin to feel.
We use our eyes to see.
We use our ears to hear.
We use our tongue to taste.
We use our nose to smell.
